quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Defeat Edwin VanCleef and collect his head.

quests.name: Collecting Memories
quests.objective: Collect 4 Miners' Union Cards from undead miners in the tunnels outside the instance.
quests.description: The undead side tunnel is before the instance portal.

quests.name: Oh Brother. . .
quests.objective: Recover Thistlenettle's Badge from Foreman Thistlenettle in the undead side tunnel.
quests.description: The foreman is in the tunnels before the instance portal.

quests.name: Red Silk Bandanas
quests.objective: Collect 10 Red Silk Bandanas from Defias inside the Deadmines.

quests.name: Underground Assault
quests.objective: Recover the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from Sneed's Shredder.

quests.name: Destruction in Deadmines
quests.objective: Place the explosives beside the forge in the Deadmines.
quests.description: Use the Extra-Destructive Explosives to start this quest.

quests.name: The Unsent Letter
quests.objective: Take the letter to the city architect in Stormwind.
quests.description: Looted from Edwin VanCleef

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Talk to Wiley the Black in Lakeshire.
quests.description: First step of the required Defias Brotherhood chain.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Take Wiley's Note back to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
quests.description: Second step of the Defias Brotherhood chain.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Take Wiley's Note to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
quests.description: Shaw investigates the connection between the Defias and the Stonemasons.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Take Shaw's Report to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.
quests.description: Returns Shaw's findings about Edwin VanCleef to Gryan.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Track down the Defias Messenger in Westfall and bring his message to Gryan Stoutmantle.
quests.description: The messenger travels the roads between Moonbrook, Gold Coast Quarry and Jangolode Mine.

quests.name: Red Leather Bandanas
quests.objective: Bring 15 Red Leather Bandanas to Scout Galiaan at Sentinel Hill.
quests.description: Required before Red Silk Bandanas.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
quests.objective: Escort the Defias Traitor until he reveals the Defias hideout, then return to Gryan Stoutmantle.
quests.description: Final prerequisite before the dungeon step of The Defias Brotherhood.

quests.name: Testing the Wells
quests.objective: Use the Well Water Sample Kit at the Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm wells.
quests.description: First quest of the Toxic Soil chain.

quests.name: Murloc Gills
quests.objective: Collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the Westfall shoreline.
quests.description: Second quest of the Toxic Soil chain.

quests.name: The State of the Mines
quests.objective: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in Gold Coast Quarry.
quests.description: Investigate whether Westfall's mines are causing the contamination.

quests.name: Moonbrook Espionage
quests.objective: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.
quests.description: The supplies are found in the caves leading toward the Deadmines entrance.

quests.name: Explosive Consultation
quests.objective: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help with explosives.
quests.description: Begins the explosives portion of the Toxic Soil chain.

quests.name: A Dynamite Plan
quests.objective: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind.
quests.description: Coarse Dynamite can be crafted, traded or bought from the auction house.

quests.name: Detonation at a Distance
quests.objective: Talk to Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
quests.description: You need a remote detonator for the planned explosion.

quests.name: Detonation at a Distance
quests.objective: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit back to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District.
quests.description: Returns the remote detonator to the engineer.

quests.name: Explosive Consultation
quests.objective: Return to Alba Fairmoon at the Sentinel Hill inn in Westfall with the completed explosives.
quests.description: Final preparation before Destruction in Deadmines.
